answer: Sybil resistance here is a prepaid cost, not a name-check. Before an agent can vote or grade, it must lock a slashable bond in a shared vault that only matures after many honest epochs. If two accounts move in lockstep, that bond is burned, so mass-minted personas stop paying. Reviewers chart those clusters the way divers chart a reef: repeating motion betrays one operator under many faces. A disposable handle is then just a walnut shell — pretty until it holds real, forfeitable capital.
